Rocky Mountain Area(PL 3)   
Fire Activity and Teams Assigned Totals 
New fires: 13 
New large incidents: 3 
Uncontained large fires: 9 
CIMTs Committed: 3 
 
Aspen Acres, Custer County. CIMT (RM Team 3). Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal 
fire behavior with creeping, flanking and backing. Numerous residences threatened. Area, road and trail 
closures in effect. 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 1). Two miles north 
of Ouray, CO. Grass, brush and timber. Minimal fire behavior with backing, creeping and smoldering. 
Numerous structures and critical infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (NW Team 8). Seven miles northwest of 
Lake City, CO. Timber, heavy slash and grass. Minimal fire behavior with creeping, single tree torching and 
smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior with smoldering, creeping and isolated torching. Residences and communication 
infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area 
yesterday. 
 
Ferris, San Juan NF, USFS. Seven miles east of Cahone, CO. Timber and brush. Minimal fire behavior with 
smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
* Kohns, Campbell County. Twenty miles northeast of Gillette, WY. Grass and brush. Extreme fire behavior 
with wind-driven runs, isolated torching and short-range spotting. Structures threatened. 
 
* Long Draw, Crook County. Twenty-five miles northwest of Sundance, WY. Timber and grass. Moderate fire 
behavior with smoldering and creeping. Residences threatened. 
 
Fuhr Gulch, Moffat County. Three miles southwest of Craig, CO. Brush and grass. Minimal fire behavior. Last 
report unless significant activity occurs. 
 
Keystone, White River Field Office, BLM. Forty-five miles northwest of Meeker, CO. Brush, timber and 
dormant brush. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Residences threatened. Last report unless 
significant activity occurs.
